causal_question: Do full search visit distributions transfer more useful policy information than the same teacher's selected action?

arms.action: one-hot action selected by the search teacher

training.initialization: identical accepted r1 checkpoint for every arm
training.loss: policy cross-entropy on deployment head only

decision_gates: Every checkpoint must reload through LocalFinetunedModel with the exact r1 schema and legal normalized probabilities.
Offline loss and agreement are diagnostics only; they cannot promote a policy.
Primary teachability comparison is visits minus action on an independently evaluated frozen opponent panel.
A surviving student is evaluated directly first, then inside the otherwise frozen r1 search stack.
Search budget, c_puct, determinization sampler, opponent priors, and final visit selector remain identical between candidate and r1.
No ladder run occurs before the paired local H2H gate passes.
